crossRefs.note: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

translations.web: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”
translations.bsb: “This temple took forty-six years to build,” the Jews replied, “and You are going to raise it up in three days?”
translations.kjv: Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou rear it up in three days?
translations.asv: The Jews therefore said, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and wilt thou raise it up in three days?
